dialogue.origin: こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.content: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.origin: お時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきますね
dialogue.content: Once it’s time, I’ll go ahead and begin.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: すみません評価が遅くなるかもしれません家族を迎えにいかないといけないので
dialogue.content: I’m sorry, my feedback might be delayed because I need to pick up a family member.

dialogue.origin: 全然大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.content: That's perfectly fine.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ご都合のよいところでまたお願いします
dialogue.content: Please do it at your convenience.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは相談員です本日はご相談に来ていただきありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.origin: まずはじめに、ご年齢と性別を教えていただけますか
dialogue.content: First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうかどんなことでも、お話しやすいところからで大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today? Feel free to start from wherever is easiest for you.

dialogue.origin: 50代女性
dialogue.content: I’m a woman in my 50s.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただき、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: いまの職場が苦痛でしかたありません
dialogue.content: My current workplace is just unbearable.

dialogue.origin: それはおつらいですよね、、
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なかなか馴染めなくて
dialogue.content: I'm having a hard time fitting in.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それは毎日行くのがしんどくなりますよね
dialogue.content: I imagine that makes it hard to go to work every day.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです挨拶してもそっけない感じで嫌なのです
dialogue.content: It is. Even when I greet people, they're so curt. I hate it.

dialogue.origin: それは嫌になりますよね
dialogue.content: I can see how that would feel discouraging.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いつ頃からそんな感じなのでしょうか
dialogue.content: When did it start feeling like that?

dialogue.origin: ん…入って間もなくくらいですね
dialogue.content: Mmm... It's been like this since shortly after I started.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どれくらい今の会社にはお勤めになられているのでしょうか
dialogue.content: How long have you been working at your current company?

dialogue.origin: 入って半年ぐらいです
dialogue.content: It's been about six months since I started.

dialogue.origin: なんかパートさんの雰囲気が悪くて
dialogue.content: The atmosphere among the part-time staff is just bad.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、、
dialogue.content: I see…

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご自身は、職場ではどういったポジションで働いておられますか
dialogue.content: What is your position at work?

dialogue.origin: 今は転職したばかりで教えて頂いてます。販売です
dialogue.content: I just changed jobs, so I'm still in training. It's in sales.

dialogue.origin: 販売というか売り場の商品管理みたいな感じです
dialogue.content: Well, not exactly sales, more like merchandise management on the sales floor.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、詳しく教えていただてありがとうございます
dialogue.content: I see, thank you for explaining in detail.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: せっかく転職した会社で、いきなり雰囲気が悪いとやりにくいですよね、、
dialogue.content: It must be difficult to start at a new company you've just switched to, only to find the atmosphere is bad from the get-go.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: どんなところで、雰囲気が悪いと感じますか
dialogue.content: In what ways do you feel the atmosphere is bad?

dialogue.origin: さっきも書きましたが　挨拶してもそっけないです後なんか　グループがあるみたいで
dialogue.content: As I mentioned earlier, they're curt even when I greet them. Also, it seems like there are cliques.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、それはやりづらいですよね
dialogue.content: I see, that must make things difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 新しく入ってきて、どうふるまったらいいか悩んでしまいますよね
dialogue.content: Being new, it must be hard to know how to act.

dialogue.origin: そうんです本当にどっちのチームと聞かれてもわからないのに…苦痛です
dialogue.content: Exactly. And it's painful when they ask me which team I'm on, when I don't even know...

dialogue.origin: ええっ・・そんなこと聞かれても困ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: Wow… being asked something like that would leave you at a loss.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですよね私が対立してる訳でもないのに
dialogue.content: It is. It's not like I'm the one in conflict with anyone.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、本当にそうですよね
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, you're absolutely right.

dialogue.origin: 放っておいて欲しいと思いますよね
dialogue.content: You probably wish they’d just leave you out of it.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですどちらも指導してくれるのでなんとも感じないのに
dialogue.content: Exactly. Both sides are training me, so I don't feel any particular way about either of them.

dialogue.origin: うんうん（聞いていますね）
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm (I’m listening).

dialogue.origin: どちらにも愛想がいいので風見鶏みたいなことを言われてもまだ入ったばかりなのに
dialogue.content: Because I’m friendly to both, they’ve even called me a fence-sitter, even though I’ve only just started.

dialogue.origin: だから　そっけないのかな
dialogue.content: Maybe that's why they're so curt.

dialogue.origin: そんなこと言われたら、きついですよね、、
dialogue.content: That must be very harsh to hear.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そろそろ限界かも知れないです
dialogue.content: I think I might be reaching my limit.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そんな状況だと毎日とてもしんどくなるのは当然だと思います
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, it's completely understandable that you'd feel worn out every day in a situation like that.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今、体調の方はいかがですか
dialogue.content: How are you feeling physically right now?

dialogue.origin: 体調は胃が痛いのですがなんか過食になっているみたいで
dialogue.content: Physically, my stomach hurts, and I think I've been overeating.

dialogue.origin: ストレスがあると食べてしまいます
dialogue.content: I tend to eat when I'm stressed.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、それは心配ですよね
dialogue.content: I see, that's concerning.

dialogue.origin: 心配?
dialogue.content: Concerning?

dialogue.origin: 私がですか
dialogue.content: Me?

dialogue.origin: はい、ストレスで過食ということで、お身体が心配かなと感じました
dialogue.content: Yes, hearing that you're overeating due to stress, I felt concerned about your health.

dialogue.origin: 体が心配ではないですが苦痛です
dialogue.content: I'm not worried about my health, but it is distressing.

dialogue.origin: 太るのは心配ですw w
dialogue.content: I do worry about gaining weight, though, haha.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうでしたかww
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, I see, haha.

dialogue.origin: 確かに、職場のことを考えると苦痛でしかないですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, thinking about your workplace must be nothing but distressing.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 職場では、少し気軽にお話しできる方とかはおられますか
dialogue.content: Is there anyone at work you feel you can talk to casually?

dialogue.origin: 皆さん結構長い方が多くてあまり言えないです
dialogue.content: Most of them have been there for a long time, so I can't really say much.

dialogue.origin: 新しいのは私ぐらいで
dialogue.content: I'm pretty much the only new person.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、それは気を使ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must make you feel like you have to be very careful.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そんなふうにチームになって対立しているのを見て、ご自身ではどんなふうに感じていますか
dialogue.content: How do you personally feel when you see them forming teams and being in conflict like that?

dialogue.origin: 大人気ないと思いますこの年になってまだチームで対抗するなんて　考えられないと思っています。でもまだ入ったばかりですぐ辞めるのはどうかなと思って
dialogue.content: I think it's childish. I can't believe people at this age are still ganging up in teams. But I've only just started, so I'm wondering if it's okay to quit so soon.

dialogue.origin: そんなふうに感じておられるのですね
dialogue.content: So that's how you feel about it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 確かに同じ職場なのに、なんで？って思いますよね
dialogue.content: It does make you wonder, "Why?" when you're all working at the same place, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです古株同士の争いに入らないと駄目なのかなと嫌な気持ちになります
dialogue.content: Exactly. It makes me feel awful, wondering if I have to get involved in a conflict between the old-timers.

dialogue.origin: 本当にそんなことに巻き込まれるのは、ごめんですよね
dialogue.content: You really don't want to get dragged into something like that.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: No, I don't.

dialogue.origin: 職場の上司とかは、そのような状況について何かおっしゃっていましたか
dialogue.content: Has your boss or anyone in a management position said anything about this situation?

dialogue.origin: 黙ってみていますパートさんのほうが社員よりも長い方が多いので
dialogue.content: They just watch in silence. Many of the part-timers have been there longer than the full-time employees.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですよね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: がっかりしていしますよね
dialogue.content: That must be disappointing.

dialogue.origin: がっかりというか若い社員だから仕方ないかと
dialogue.content: Not so much disappointing as... I guess it can't be helped since the employees are young.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そんなふうな視点でも見ておられるのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you're also looking at it from that perspective.

dialogue.origin: そんな風な視点?私の考え方ですか？
dialogue.content: That perspective? You mean my way of thinking?

dialogue.origin: おかしいのかな
dialogue.content: Is that strange?

dialogue.origin: これまでのキャリアがおありだからこそ、他の人には見えていないことが、見えていることがあるのではないかと感じました
dialogue.content: I felt that because of your past career experience, you might be seeing things that other people don't.

dialogue.origin: なるほどありがとうございます
dialogue.content: I see, thank you.

dialogue.origin: 本当にそうだと思います
dialogue.content: I truly believe so.

dialogue.origin: ご自身では、これからどんなふうになっていけたらいいかなというのは何かありますか
dialogue.content: Do you have any thoughts on how you'd like things to be for yourself from now on?

dialogue.origin: そうですねまわりに振り回されないようにしようかなと思います。我慢できなければ辞めればいいかな
dialogue.content: Well, I think I'll try not to be swayed by those around me. If I can't stand it anymore, I guess I can just quit.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、しっかりとご自身の軸をもっておられると感じました
dialogue.content: I see. I feel that you have a strong sense of self.

dialogue.origin: そう言って頂けると嬉しいです
dialogue.content: I’m glad to hear you say that.

dialogue.origin: 今の職場の皆さんは、チーム同士の対立が当たり前だと思っています
dialogue.content: Everyone at your current workplace thinks that this conflict between teams is normal.

dialogue.origin: でも、あなたが感じておられるように、同じ職場でチーム同士で対立しているなんてありえない、間違いなく、あなたの感じていることは正しいと私は思います
dialogue.content: But, just as you feel, it's not right for teams to be in conflict in the same workplace. I believe what you're feeling is undoubtedly correct.

dialogue.origin: そうですねまぁ　そっけない態度は辛いですが
dialogue.content: That's true. Well, their curt attitude is hard to take, though.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そこは嫌になりますよね
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm, that part is discouraging.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今日お話させていただいて、あなたがおっしゃる通り、しっかりと本当はこうなんだよ、チームって協力するもんなんだよっていう価値観を持って振り回されないことが、私もとても大切なことだと思いました
dialogue.content: After talking with you today, I also think it's very important, as you said, to hold onto your values—that this is how things should be, that teams should cooperate—and not be swayed by them.

dialogue.origin: ご自身ではいかがですか
dialogue.content: How do you feel about that?

dialogue.origin: そうですね職場の方はどうなのかわかりませんがとりあえずしばらくは頑張ります
dialogue.content: That's right. I don't know what will happen with my coworkers, but for now, I'll try my best for a while.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、是非頑張って前に進んでみてくださいそんなあなたを全力で応援しています
dialogue.content: Yes, please do your best and try to move forward. I'll be cheering for you with all my might.

dialogue.origin: それでは、そろそろお時間となりましたので、本日のご相談終了としたいと思いますが、よろしいでしょうか
dialogue.content: Well, our time is almost up, so I'd like to conclude today's session, if that's alright with you.

dialogue.origin: はいありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: はい、こちらこそ大切なお話聞かせていただきありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you as well for sharing such important things with me.

dialogue.origin: それでは、これで終了とさせていただきます
dialogue.content: With that, we’ll conclude here.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: お疲れさまでした！
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time today!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: それでは失礼いたします
dialogue.content: Goodbye, then. Take care.

topic.sub: 職場の雰囲気が悪い問題
